description: This Java source file defines the PhotoThumbnailFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a grid of photo thumbnails retrieved from a remote Picasa RSS feed. It manages loading data via a CursorLoader, setting up the UI grid, handling item clicks to view full images, and downloading images asynchronously.

classes.name: PhotoThumbnailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a grid of photo thumbnails fetched from an online Picasa RSS feed, manages data loading, view setup, and interaction handling.

classes.name: PhotoThumbnailFragment.GridViewAdapter
classes.description: A custom CursorAdapter that binds photo thumbnail URLs from a database cursor to the grid view items, inflating views and loading images asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader for querying photo URLs from the local database.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes the grid view and its adapter, sets up display metrics, starts data download if needed, and restores state.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Destroys loader and cursor adapter when fragment is detached.

methods.name: onHiddenChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility state changes of the fragment.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on a thumbnail, retrieves the full image URL, and broadcasts an intent to display the image.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates the adapter's cursor with new data once query completes.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the adapter's cursor when loader is reset.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the fragment's visibility state for restoration.

methods.name: setLoaded
methods.description: Sets internal state flag indicating whether data has been loaded.
